en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Aim of the course and learning outcomes: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with issues in the main areas of international economic interactions, consisting primarily of international trade. The course approaches the theme from the perspective of international economics and the emphasis is also on the intertwining and mutual influence of political and economic dimensions. In the first part of the course, students will get acquainted with the historical development of economic globalization, theoretical approaches to the study of international economics and the main areas of international economic interactions. Some specific topics related to international trade will also be discussed in a more similar way. As part of the exercise, students will learn to use methods of empirical analysis of international trade. Course content: 1. International trade and world economy (allowance 4/0) 2. Theory of international trade (allowance 4/0) 3. Trade policy (allowance 8/0) 4. Aspects of foreign trade operations (allowance 6/0) 5. The role of the EU in the world economy and the common commercial policy (allowance 4/0) 6. Empirical analyzes of foreign trade (allowance 0/13)
